verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents several official SDKs a developer can build against on this GPU. These include the CUDA Toolkit (libraries, compiler, runtime, debugging tools), CUDA Tile in Python and C++, CUDA-X/RAPIDS, the Video Codec SDK with Blackwell-specific NVENC/NVDEC features, and the RTX Neural Shaders SDK. One community report adds a real caveat: SM120 (this card) lacks tmem/tcgen05 and has weaker support in major libraries than SM100 data-center parts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of building with these SDKs on this card, explicit SDK support coverage for SM120, and closing the library-support gap the community report describes.
